# Decisions

Rulings are David's. Proposals are Claude's and stay marked until David rules. Numbers carry over from the demo's `DECISIONS.md` and `arkhe-candidates.md`. Rulings marked _(to build)_ are ruled but not yet in the code.

## Proposed (Claude, pending David)

| #   | Proposal                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | Where                                      |
| --- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| P34 | Text direction (audit #3, #27, #28). Arkhé reads `dir` from the DOM at the trigger (`closest('[dir]')`, else `<html dir>`), `ArkheEnvironment` may override it, and every `*MachineProps` builder passes it to Zag. Portal wrappers copy it, so floating parts keep an RTL region's direction. Today Zag stamps `dir="ltr"` on Tabs and NumericInput parts, and portalled parts drop out of `dir="rtl"` subtrees | `environment.ts`, `*MachineProps`, portals |
| P35 | Svelte NumericInput ownership (audit #1, #41). Svelte cannot tell `bind:value` from a one-way `value`, and writing a one-way prop makes a local override that hides the parent. So: with `onValueChange` the host owns `value` as in React and the field never writes it; without it `value` binds, even from undefined. `bind:value` plus `onValueChange` must set the bound variable in the callback           | `NumericInput.svelte`                      |
| P36 | Modal `finalFocus` (audit #71): optional `finalFocus?: () => HTMLElement \| null` on `ModalProps` in both ports, passed to Zag's `finalFocusEl`. No automatic fallback when the opener is gone; the host picks the target                                                                                                                                                                                        | `dialog.ts`, `Modal`                       |
| P37 | Modal in a shadow root (audit #74): core `hideShadowSiblings(content)` sets `aria-hidden` on everything in the content's shadow root beside its path while open, skips live regions and already-hidden nodes, restores on close. No count across nested modals, unlike Zag's own hiding                                                                                                                          | `dialog.ts`, `Modal`                       |
| P38 | Announcing pre-filled live regions (audit #33, #66): a polite `Status` and `SkeletonGroup` re-insert their own children `LIVE_REGION_DELAY` (100 ms) after mount, via core `announceOnMount`, so readers see a change in a region they already track. Final DOM is unchanged; alerts are left alone                                                                                                              | `status.ts`, `Status`, `SkeletonGroup`     |
